name: qr-menu-idea
description: QR Menu Smart Ordering System — Monorepo

scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n api,admin,menu,kitchen,super-admin,gateway "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:menu" "npm run dev:kitchen" "npm run dev:super-admin" "npm run dev:gateway"
scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client/admin && npm install && cd ../menu && npm install && cd ../kitchen && npm install && cd ../super-admin && npm install && cd ../../gateway && npm install
scripts.build:server: npm ci --include=dev --prefix server && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.build:admin: npm ci --include=dev --prefix client/admin && npm run build --prefix client/admin
scripts.build:menu: npm ci --include=dev --prefix client/menu && npm run build --prefix client/menu
scripts.build:kitchen: npm ci --include=dev --prefix client/kitchen && npm run build --prefix client/kitchen
scripts.build:super-admin: npm ci --include=dev --prefix client/super-admin && npm run build --prefix client/super-admin
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:admin && npm run build:menu && npm run build:kitchen && npm run build:super-admin
